# Quizymode

> Quizymode is a free study and quiz platform. Browse categories of multiple-choice questions, study with explanations, take quizzes, and build your own collections.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.quizymode.com/): Overview and entry point
- [Starter quiz](https://www.quizymode.com/start): Try a quiz without signing up
- [Categories](https://www.quizymode.com/categories): Browse all topics and subtopics
- [Collections](https://www.quizymode.com/collections): Curated sets of questions
- [About](https://www.quizymode.com/about): What Quizymode is

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.quizymode.com/sitemap.xml): All public URLs
- [Privacy](https://www.quizymode.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.quizymode.com/terms)
